note: Training-trajectory golden for the FP16-storage policy, checked by validation/verify_training_state.py: every parameter, both Adam moments, per-slot step counters, losses, recurrent states and initial-state adjoints after each update, keyed per device. The suite runs once per arm -- the shipped LN1/low-rank topology first, then each packed-FP16 variant forced through HIERARCHOS_RWKV_LOW_RANK_LN_FORWARD_TOPOLOGY -- and every variant has to be bit-identical to the kernel these trajectories were recorded with.

baseline.recorded_with: The FP16 parameter-storage policy on the shipped kernels, with the uncommitted LN1/low-rank scheduling work in the working tree on top of base_commit. Unlike training_state.json this is not a pre-optimization artifact: it pins the packed-FP16 producer's variants to each other, while the FP32 golden pins the trajectory to the earlier baseline.
